applicabilityBasis.summary: tGBP is presented as a GBP-backed stablecoin with mint-and-redeem functionality, so its token-level design is an apparent payment stablecoin under the GENIUS definition even though its U.S. distribution was not established.

genius.licensingRegulator: UK Financial Conduct Authority cryptoasset AML registration (FRN 928840); this is not a GENIUS authorization
genius.notes: BCP's FCA registration and sandbox participation establish UK regulatory context only. No public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or registered foreign-issuer exception was located for BCP Technologies Ltd or tGBP. The reviewed product materials also did not establish that tGBP is offered to U.S. persons, so the payment-stablecoin applicability call is product-based rather than a finding of U.S. distribution.
